demo.aClickWithoutMovementUnder: A click without movement (under 4 px) selects the card; the four side-midpoint anchors are invisible geometry and the edge snaps to the nearest pair. Drag the notepad or the photo: it follows the pointer one to one and the zone shows what a release would do — a dashed slot where the item lands, the other item making room, the frame shrinking around the remaining item when you pull one out. Release over the other free item to group both into a new zone (above/below stacks, left/right places side by side); release away from the zone to keep the item free. Nothing is committed before the release, and every settle uses the same calm ease-out. Click the zone name in its header to rename it: Enter keeps the new name, Escape restores the old one, an empty name returns to the default; a zone formed by grouping starts as “New zone”. Drag a zone by its frame or header to move it together with its items. Click any object to select it and drag an edge or a corner of its frame to resize it; Lena and Jonas work on the same board as simulated teammates, each with a cursor, a name and a selection in their colour; a photo dropped into a zone takes the size of the other item. Dragged objects snap to their neighbours (Shift moves freely); Shift-drag on the empty canvas selects several objects; right-click opens the menu, Delete removes, Cmd/Ctrl+Z undoes. When both items are out the empty zone fades away; toolbar, zone and zoom pill are preview-only: a tool click only selects it and changes nothing on the canvas.

motion.title: Motion, interaction and layers
motion.intro: Durations, thresholds and the stacking order the canvas and its chrome share. Things move with transform and opacity only, never with springs; under reduced motion every transition is 0 ms (design law §7). Point at a duration to play it.
motion.layersNote: From packages/ui-kit/layers.ts (design law §8); nothing above 10 without an entry there.
chrome.headerNote: 40 px band in faint with a hairline rule; the name is one line with an ellipsis; the delete button stays invisible until hover, focus or selection (L02).
chrome.selectionTitle: Selection, resize frame and count bar
chrome.selectionNote: A 1 px accent frame per selected object; on a single selection the frame’s edges and corners resize it — the hovered edge lights up as a 2 px line, a corner as a 16 px bracket — and one count bar with a delete button sits above the group (L10, L14).
chrome.bandNote: Shift-drag on the empty canvas: a soft accent fill with a 1 px accent border; on release every touched object is selected (L10).
chrome.snapNote: Edges and centres within 6 screen px snap; at most three 1 px accent guides, 16 px past both objects; Shift moves freely (L07).
chrome.highlightNote: A drop with the centre inside a zone makes the object a member; the zone is outlined in accent-line for one second (L08).
chrome.undoNote: After an undo the bottom-centre slot shows what was undone for 3 s; no toast queue, no layout shift (L11, design law §9).
chrome.menuNote: Right-click, Shift+F10 or the menu key: 200 px wide, 32 px rows, shortcuts right-aligned in muted; arrow keys, Enter and Esc (L12).

rules.title: The design law, rule by rule
rules.intro: Every rule of docs/design-rules.md, §0 to §14, in short. MUST means must, NEVER means never; each card names where this page shows the rule at work.
rules.s0.title: §0 Guiding idea
rules.s0.r1: Content first, tool quiet. The person's notes are the brightest thing on the screen; bars, frames and buttons recede.
rules.s0.r2: Calm instead of colourful. Dark green-grey, one accent (--accent, sage), otherwise greys.
rules.s0.r3: Nothing jumps. No element changes its position, size or text unless the person triggered it.
rules.s0.r4: When in doubt: fewer elements, less colour, less motion. Whoever wants to deviate asks first and does not build.
rules.s1.title: §1 Working rules
rules.s1.r1: MUST read AGENTS.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, the design law, the own catalogue entry and its listed files before the first line of code.
rules.s1.r2: MUST implement exactly one catalogue entry per task — nothing improved on the side.
rules.s1.r3: MUST tick every acceptance checkbox individually (✓ / ✗ + one sentence).
rules.s1.r4: MUST store before/after screenshots at 1440×900 and 390×844 under reviews/evidence/.
rules.s1.r5: MUST work in the task's worktree, take ports and names only from .polier-slot, run every gate through gate.py and commit its records.
rules.s1.r6: MUST keep lint, typecheck and unit checks green and run the named e2e specs.
rules.s1.r7: NEVER a new dependency, NEVER change or delete existing tests, NEVER touch files outside the entry's list — ask instead.
rules.s1.r8: NEVER guess: unclear goes to open_questions. NEVER deliver TODOs, placeholders or commented-out code.
rules.s2.title: §2 Colours
rules.s2.r1: MUST use only tokens from packages/ui-kit/tokens.json — CSS custom properties on the web, the generated header in the engine.
rules.s2.r2: NEVER new hex, rgb or rgba values in components; a missing tone is a question, new tokens need approval.
rules.s2.r4: --tone-a … --tone-e only for zones, palettes, edges and person colours.
rules.s2.r5: Accent sparingly: at most one filled accent button per screen; otherwise accent only for selection, focus and snap lines.
rules.s3.title: §3 Spacing, sizes, radii
rules.s3.r2: Canvas grid 16 px for snapping, sizes and positions.
rules.s3.r3: Click targets at least 32 × 32 px with a mouse, 44 × 44 px on coarse pointers.
rules.s3.r4: Note card --radius-md (14), block and zone --radius-lg (20), icon button and field --radius-sm (10), text button outside the canvas --radius-pill.
rules.s3.r5: NEVER pill buttons inside cards or blocks — there an icon button or a --muted text link.
rules.s4.title: §4 Type
rules.s4.r1: Board, panel and empty-state titles in --font-serif 28 / 24 / 22 px; card and block titles 15 px semibold; body 13 px at 1.4.
rules.s4.r2: Type label 11 px uppercase +0.1em in --accent; status and hints 12 px --muted; tooltip 12 px medium.
rules.s4.r3: NEVER text below 11 px. NEVER more than two weights in one card.
rules.s4.r4: Long titles: one line with an ellipsis, the full title in the tooltip — NEVER clipped text without an ellipsis.
rules.s5.title: §5 Icons
rules.s5.r1: MUST come from packages/ui-kit/icons/: own SVGs, 24 grid, stroke 1.6, currentColor, round caps — the same files for web and engine.
rules.s5.r2: 20 px icon in a 36 px bar button, 16 px icon in a 28 px card button.
rules.s5.r3: NEVER emoji, Unicode characters as icons (×, ✓, →) or icon libraries.
rules.s5.r4: Icon buttons MUST have aria-label from the translation files and data-label for the tooltip — NEVER the native title.
rules.s6.title: §6 States
rules.s6.r1: Every interactive element — engine objects included — has rest, hover, pressed, focus, selected, dragged, disabled, saving, saved and error.
rules.s6.r2: Focus: 2 px --accent outline, 2 px offset — NEVER removed. Pressed: hover plus scale(0.97).
rules.s6.r3: Selected card or block: 1.5 px --accent border with a 3 px --accent-soft ring. Being dragged: --shadow, opacity 1 — NEVER semi-transparent.
rules.s6.r4: Disabled: opacity 0.4, no hover. Saving / saved: 12 px --muted in a fixed-height status slot, “saved” fades after 2 s; errors stay in --danger and keep the input.
rules.s6.r5: Done checklist entry: text --muted, tick in --accent — NEVER struck through.
rules.s6.r6: Controls inside cards and blocks are invisible at rest and appear on hover, focus within or selection; they stay reachable by keyboard and show on touch when selected.
rules.s7.title: §7 Motion
rules.s7.r1: Hover and colour 120 ms ease; show and hide 150 ms; panel 180 ms ease-out, only transform and opacity.
rules.s7.r2: Tooltips after 300 ms of dwell, immediately on keyboard focus.
rules.s7.r3: NEVER bounce, springs, wobble, confetti or animated numbers.
rules.s7.r5: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce every transition is 0 ms.
rules.s8.title: §8 Layers
rules.s8.r1: From the bottom up — 1 canvas background, 2 edges, 3 zones, 4 blocks, 5 note cards, 6 dragged or selected, 7 snap guides and selection frame, 7a remote cursors, 8 canvas chrome, 9 side panel, 10 context menu and tooltip, 11 dialogs and toasts.
rules.s8.r2: The same order is the engine's render order and the DOM's z-order.
rules.s8.r3: Edges lie below every object, zones included: a line never crosses a zone's surface or title (ADR-0013).
rules.s8.r4: NEVER a z-index above 10 without an entry in packages/ui-kit/layers.ts.
rules.s9.title: §9 Canvas chrome
rules.s9.r1: Toolbar top centre, zoom control bottom left, save and error hint bottom centre — all floating, 12 px from the edge.
rules.s9.r2: Side panel on the right, overlapping the canvas, 400 px wide, 12 px from the edge.
rules.s9.r3: NEVER more floating elements; NEVER rows of buttons above the canvas.
rules.s9.r4: “Show all” keeps at least 64 px free at the top; the zoom control is always fully visible.
rules.s10.title: §10 Texts
rules.s10.r1: MUST come from translation files with English keys, German first, in the informal address.
rules.s10.r2: Short: a button ≤ 2 words, a tooltip ≤ 3 words, an error ≤ 1 sentence plus what the person can do.
rules.s10.r3: NEVER exclamation marks, “Ups” or technical terms (node, block ID, payload).
rules.s10.r4: Terms as in the German glossary, NEVER two words for the same thing; German always uses “ss”.
rules.s11.title: §11 Acceptance of every UI entry
rules.s11.r1: No colour value outside the tokens — the design-check gate rejects raw hex, rgb, rgba and hsl values.
rules.s11.r2: All spacing from the 4 px series; every §6 state present and reachable by keyboard.
rules.s11.r3: No text clipped without an ellipsis and none below 11 px; nothing jumps on hover, save, open or close.
rules.s11.r4: At 390 px width nothing overflows and everything is operable; before/after screenshots are in reviews/evidence/.
rules.s12.title: §12 Realtime cursors and selection
rules.s12.r1: Other people's cursors: a 16 px cursor with a 12 px name label on a surface in the person's colour (--tone-a … --tone-e).
rules.s12.r2: After 5 s without movement a remote cursor fades to opacity 0.4.
rules.s12.r3: Another person's selection is a 1.5 px frame in their colour without a ring; the own selection follows §6.
rules.s13.title: §13 Engine
rules.s13.r1: No design numbers in C++ outside the generated tokens.h: radii, borders, shadows and the 4 px drag, 6 px snap, 16 px grid and 40 px header thresholds are tokens.
rules.s13.r2: The engine reads every design value from tokens.json through the header and never keeps its own copy.
rules.s14.title: §14 Layout for translation
rules.s14.r3: The engine shows no text of its own; object content is the only text it draws.
